description: Source file for language and localization management in the Wesnoth game, including language definitions, locale setting, and translation initialization.

classes.name: language_def
classes.description: Structure representing a language, including its code and display name.

classes.name: symbol_table
classes.description: Class managing a table of translation strings.

methods.name: get_languages
methods.description: Returns a list of supported language definitions.

methods.name: set_language
methods.description: Sets the current language and loads translations.

methods.name: get_locale
methods.description: Determines and returns the current locale setting.

methods.name: init_textdomains
methods.description: Initializes text domains for translations based on configuration.
